specifications.title: MOBILITY / HIGH-CUT HELMET SERIES
specifications.layout: Landscape2ROWS×4COLUMNS: top EDEL, bottom SERIN; columns H-C1 BASIC, H-B1 STANDARD, H-A1 MODULAR, H-S1 ADVANCED. Exactly8primaryhelmetbusts =4products.
specifications.body:
ROLE: LIGHT/HIGH-CUT shell, open ear/temple area, face fully open, trim raised rear edge and a small unobtrusive chin strap. Clearly light agile silhouette, not a full-face heavy dome or a service hard-hat brim. Palette DEEP TEAL/CHARCOAL with restrained cool mint/ice accents; original hair never recolored.
H-C1 탐색경량: very plain high-cut rounded cap shell with small edge lip, minimal attachments/strap, no large optics.
H-B1 훈련경량: slightly more complete smooth continuous high-cut shell with one bold brow band and simple side slots/retention, practical finished rim distinct from C.
H-A1 군용정찰: separately outlined angular forehead plate/crown panel, compact side rail/low rear retention pad, one small communications fitting; ear/face stay open and elegant.
H-S1 특수부대경량: refined segmented high-cut crown/forehead frame, thin platinum/teal inlay, small sculptural temple connectors, geometric ornamental marks and tiny ice-cyan light edges. Optional SHORT CLEAR brow lens folded UP, not over eyes. Compact futuristic highest-grade style, no giant goggles or heavy face shell. Match S1 suit's premium finishing.
Make front/rear outline and connection method progress by tier, not four identical helmets with more clips. Main original faces/fringe/braid/ponytail visible.
specifications.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Design ORIGINAL HELMETS for the user's anime extraction-shooter, fitted visually to the existing SD heroines and coordinated with the SELECTED suit+compact armor concepts.
Input1 = selected role armor board, authoritative for character identity/proportions, role palette, C/B/A/S finishing and ADVANCED near-future decoration. EDEL top row: original lavender bob/braid/loop ahoge/blue eyes. SERIN bottom: original brown ponytail/rose eyes. This is a HELMET replacement study: REMOVE Serin's pink soft cap when fitting helmet, never stack helmet over cap. Do not alter original hair COLOR, eye color, face or original SD large-head proportions. Armor visible at shoulders/chest is contextual, not a new armor redesign; selected armor source files remain unchanged.
Input2 = earlier standalone14-helmet draft. Use ONLY as broad shell-cut/visor/construction reference, NOT its olive/rust palette, male/mannequin scaling, oversized attachments or old labels. Its "game ready" text is NOT valid and must never be copied.

Main views: beautifully rendered HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS / upper chest three-quarter-front BUSTS, consistent camera/scale. Helmet dome sized to each ORIGINAL SD head, not enlarging face or turning it into a realistic adult skull. Complete helmet/hair in frame. A small SIDE/REAR head inset for EACH character/product must show real original-color hair below rim and the braid/ponytail route. Main face/eyes remain recognizable and readable. Front fringe sits naturally below brow rim, no helmet-through-hair artifacts or melted strands. EDEL braid continues over her RIGHT shoulder; SERIN original low side ponytail exits a plausible rear/side opening. Exposed nape/bob/ponytail/braid is LAVENDER for Edel and BROWN for Serin, never generic black hair or helmet-padding color. Black INNER PADDING is separate from actual hair.
Professional neutral concept presentation, pale studio backdrop, premium polished illustrated anime faces/hair and precise equipment materials. Opaque normal collar/armor context, no body emphasis. No weapon, unrelated character, male mannequin, new faction logo or copied franchise face/helmet.

Strong TIER construction ladder, always in role's distinct shell silhouette:
C BASIC = very simple clean surplus/civilian-style ONE-PIECE SHELL, minimal seam/hardware and plain chin strap; not piles of salvaged metal or busy accessories. B STANDARD = refined continuous standardized shell, pronounced simple brow/rim band, basic side closure/one practical attachment. A MODULAR = clearly SEPARATE forehead/crown/rear shell components and purposeful modular side fittings/hinges/retention, distinctive visible plate division, not B plus paint. S ADVANCED = premium NEAR-FUTURE multi-panel helmet with slim structural frame, precise metal/composite edge inlay, etched geometric decorative pattern, sculptural retention nodes and very subtle role-color recessed light accents, coordinated with selected S armor. Most elaborate but compact/elegant, no horns, crowns, animal ears, magic, giant antennas, fantasy knight ornaments or neon haze. Advanced visual technology is a cosmetic proposal, not an implemented ability.
Show real physical thickness/retention appropriate to concept but do NOT print tested/NIJ/protection certification, numbers, performance or GAME READY. Original geometry-inspired game designs, not copies of commercial products.
Footer "HELMET CONCEPTS / TWO CHARACTER FIT STUDIES / NOT 3D FITTED". Codes H-prefix are review labels, not game item database IDs. Rear/detail insets are the SAME products, not additional designs. Face covering/closed visor mode can be shown in a small inset, with expressive eyes readable in the main view.

specifications.title: HEAVY / VISOR AND FACE-PROTECTION HELMETS
specifications.layout: Landscape2ROWS×4COLUMNS: top EDEL, bottom SERIN; columns H-C2 BASIC, H-B2 STANDARD, H-A3 MODULAR, H-S3 ADVANCED. Exactly8primarybusts =4products. Note HELMET codes C2/B2 correspond to heavy armorC3/B3; do not copy armor numbering.
specifications.body:
ROLE: LOW-CUT PROTECTIVE helmet, broad brow/ear/occipital protection and progressively clear VISOR/JAW GUARD silhouette; distinctly heavier than other series but scaled to original SD face. Palette BURGUNDY/GUNMETAL/charcoal, refined not villain/medieval. Main views should show recognizable EYES/FACE through optically CLEAR visor; closed heavier protection can have a small inset. No black opaque eye slit hiding the whole character in every view.
H-C2 철판보강: plain low-cut simple reinforced crown/forehead shell, small straightforward steel-like brow reinforcement and basic straps, FACE OPEN; minimal ornaments.
H-B2 구문명진압: continuous round patrol/riot shell with strong rim band and a hinged CLEAR FULL-FACE SHIELD, clear side hinges. Actual eyes/face visible through shield; not four copies of a light high-cut helmet.
H-A3 SWAT안면보호: modular forehead/crown plates, compact split SIDE-JAW/CHIN GUARD, clear upper-face visor and purposeful side attachment. Angular practical protective silhouette, controlled width, distinct from B's simple round shield.
H-S3 저거넛안면보호: premium near-future articulated protective shell, elegant segmented lower-face/jaw frame and optically CLEAR eye/upper-face visor, precision silver/gunmetal edging, original technical ornamental inlay, small muted-red/white light details. Most protected/advanced but compact, expressive eyes remain visible, no horns/spikes/fantasy knight mask or huge robot head. Lavender/brown hair still visible at rear/nape/exit and front braid/pony.
Include small side/rear insets to show shell thickness, jaw route and original-color hair separation.

specifications.title: MAINTENANCE / FIELD SERVICE HELMET SERIES
specifications.layout: Landscape2ROWS×4COLUMNS: top EDEL, bottom SERIN; columns H-C3 BASIC, H-B3 STANDARD, H-A4 MODULAR, H-S4 ADVANCED. Exactly8primarybusts =4products. H-C3/H-B3 are service helmets paired with armorC4/B4, not heavy armorC3/B3.
specifications.body:
ROLE: SHORT-BRIM FIELD/TECHNICAL SERVICE shell, asymmetric compact side equipment and clear rear/ear retention, NOT heavy full jaw armor or generic identical combat dome. Palette AMBER/OCHRE/CHARCOAL with small ivory/metal accents; tasteful field-tech shell, not a bright industrial cone hardhat.
H-C3 작업반정비: simple short-brim protective cap shell, plain rim/strap, only one tiny practical mount; sparse basic utility form.
H-B3 수색대야전: clean one-piece field shell with a strong short brow/rim and one compact comm/utility side fitting, a CLEAR goggle/lens folded UP if used. More standardized than C but no complicated stacked gadgets.
H-A4 공병정비: visibly separate crown/forehead/rear panels and asymmetrical modular side service rail, compact inspection-module housing and low-profile ear protection, short folded CLEAR visor/lens. Integrated purposeful connection architecture, not B with more bags.
H-S4 원정대장기작전: sleek premium near-future service crown with articulated short-brow visor frame, precise platinum/amber edge inlay, tiny recessed light routes, elegant etched technical decoration and compact rear/side service-node casing. Most refined, coordinated with S4 asymmetrical suit, not magical scanner antenna crown. Visor raised/optically clear and face/eyes readable. All gadgets are visual design proposals only.
Show one small side/rear inset per character/product for asymmetrical equipment, hair port and natural original-color braid/pony route.
